title: NADH-independent enzymatic assay to quantify extracellular and intracellular L-lactate levels
protocol: Collect 2 mL of non-adherent cells in their culture medium in a 2 mL Eppendorf tube kept on ice for 5 min.
Centrifuge the collected non-adherent cells at 1,000 g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant containing cell culture medium (extracellular lactate fraction) to a new tube.
Wash the cell pellet with PBS and centrifuge as performed in step 2 of non-adherent collection.
Collect the intracellular lactate fraction quenched in 100 μL of 14% PCA without EDTA.
Incubate the collected intracellular lactate fraction on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 20,000 g and 4°C for 1 minute to collect the supernatant containing intracellular lactate.
Neutralize the supernatant to pH 7.4 with KOMO solution.
For extracellular lactate quantification, check the pH of cell culture medium collected in step 3.
Adjust the pH of cell culture medium if required using HEPES solution.
Collect the extracellular medium for adherent cells and wash the cells with PBS.
Scrape the adherent cells from plates into a 15 mL Falcon tube kept on ice.
Centrifuge the scraped cells at 1,000 g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and collect the pellet (intracellular lactate fraction).
Quench the intracellular lactate fraction in 100 μL of 14% PCA without EDTA.
Centrifuge samples at 20,000 g for 1 minute.
Collect the supernatant containing intracellular lactate.
Neutralize the supernatant to pH 7.4 with KOMO solution.
Check the pH of cell culture medium and adjust with HEPES solution if necessary.
Prepare a mix following BCA assay protocol.
In a 96-well plate, add the mix in 5 wells with defined quantities of BSA: 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 μg (final volume 200 μL per well).
Add 190 μL of mix to each well.
Add 10 μL of intracellular fraction sample per well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Measure absorbance at 562 nm.
Prepare enzyme master mix and keep it on ice.
Add the master mix in 5 wells with defined quantities of L-lactate: 0, 50, 100, 200, 2,000 pmol (200 μL final/well).
Repeat step to replicate measurement of standard curve with 0, 100, 200, 400, 2,000 pmol.
Homogenize quickly by flushing 2–3 times with a P200 pipette and incubate 5 min at room temperature before the measurement.
Add 190 μL of master mix and 10 μL of sample per well for L-lactate quantification.
Homogenize quickly by flushing 2-3 times with a P200 pipette.
Incubate the mixture 5 min at room temperature before measurement.
Add 50 pmol of L-lactate standard in well with samples.
Seed 8 × 10^6–10^7 cells per well in non-adherent conditions and between 0.5 × 10^6 to 10^6 cells per well in adherent conditions in a 6-well plate with 2 ml of cell culture medium.
Treat the seeded cells with Syrosyngopine (10 μM) and AR-C155858 (100 nM).
Add inhibitor under indicated conditions directly into the well.
Incubate treated cells at 37°C under 5% CO2 for 3 days before collecting cells to perform experiments.
